question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and fourth number is related to third number.

15 ∶ 256 ∶∶ 16 ∶ 289 ∶∶ 18 ∶ ?
solution:
**Logic :** Square of (1st number + 1) = 2nd number

So,

 
• 15 ∶ 256

(15 + 1)² = 256

(16)² = 256

256 = 256 (LHS = RHS)

And, 

 
• 16 ∶ 289

(16 + 1)² = 289

(17)² = 289

289 = 289 (LHS = RHS)

Similarly,

 
• 18 ∶ ?

(18 + 1) ² = ?

(19)² = ?

**361 = ?**

Hence, **"361"** is the correct answer.
